name: 4-Deck Phase Strip
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Compact beat-phase lanes in 3-1-2-4 order, above the waveforms.
description: Emulator preview 0.1.2. Four compact beat-phase lanes follow the native waveform order: 3, 1, 2, 4. The strip fits between the toolbar and waveform area, leaving space for Set Clock. The old Top/Band/Low placement setting is no longer used. Mod Menu controls turn the strip on/off and choose 4 DECK only or all deck layouts. Each tick is a beat, not a phrase or downbeat marker. Reads the SDK deck state and beat grid only; no hooks or audio/control changes. Physical-deck layout testing is still required.
